INTRODUCTION

Apollonius was of Alexandria by birth,[1] or so we read.


BOOK I


Beginning with thee, O Phoebus, I will recount the famous deeds
of men of old.

And men call that beach Aphetae[2] of Argo.




BOOK II


Here were the oxstalls of Amycus.

ENDNOTES:

1 "Or of Naucratis".

2 _i.e._ the place of starting.
